Name: (Experimental) Responsive MP Knockback
Author: spacechase0
Description:
Makes knockback more responsive for clients in MP. This mod is experimental, and might cause mobs to 'jump' back to the host position periodically.

This only affects clients in multiplayer. If you're the host or playing singleplayer, you won't benefit from this mod.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows.
